sources.publisher: Office for National Statistics / Ordnance Survey

coverage.scope: Modern GB and Irish urban reference, supplemented by mapped land use across Northern Ireland and its geographic collar.

limits: Not 1900 urban extent, individual buildings, population or industry.
Existing London historical detail is retained; no modern motorway or railway inferred.

building_print.basis: Modern roof outlines in selected cities active around 1900. The windows are display coverage, not historical city boundaries.
building_print.historical_london: Same Petitpierre et al. 1891–1896 roofs as the original London view, CC BY 4.0; overview only.
